extracted.name: Philly Intense summer sharing board
extracted.description: Make entertaining easy with this no-cook sharing board. Enjoy the strong flavour of Philadelphia Intense Garlic & Herbs with crudités
ingredient_lines: few handfuls of Tyrrells salted crisps
instruction_lines: Spread the Philadelphia Intense Garlic & Herbs over the middle of a small board (ours was 30 x 20cm) in a thick layer leaving a 5-10cm border.
Arrange the pepper, tomatoes, crackers and crisps around the cheese. Scatter over the basil and drizzle with olive oil, if using, to serve.
